---
title: "Commit Conventions"
---

5 requirement(s) in this category.

### CMT-001 — Conventional commit title format {#sec-cmt-001}

**Mathlib + PhysLean** · Level **SHALL**

A commit (and the PR title) SHALL follow the form `<type>(<optional-scope>): <subject>`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- The title matches `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`.
- The type is drawn from the allowed set (see CMT-002).

**Rationale.** A structured title drives changelog tooling and lets reviewers scan intent at a glance.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html>

---

### CMT-002 — Allowed commit types {#sec-cmt-002}

**Mathlib + PhysLean** · Level **SHALL**

The commit `<type>` SHALL be one of: `feat` (feature), `fix` (bug fix), `doc` (documentation), `style` (formatting), `refactor`, `test` (adding missing tests), `chore` (maintenance), `perf` (performance), `ci` (automation/workflows).

**Acceptance criteria**

- The type is one of feat, fix, doc, style, refactor, test, chore, perf, ci.

**Rationale.** A closed type vocabulary keeps history categorisable.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html>

---

### CMT-003 — Subject line style {#sec-cmt-003}

**Mathlib + PhysLean** · Level **SHALL**

The subject SHALL use the imperative present tense ('change', not 'changed' or 'changes'), SHALL NOT capitalize the first letter, and SHALL NOT end with a period. The body, if present, uses imperative present tense and gives motivation and contrast with previous behaviour.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Subject is imperative present tense.
- First letter is lower-case; there is no trailing period.

**Rationale.** A consistent grammatical form makes histories uniform and greppable.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html>

---

### CMT-004 — Scope omits the Mathlib prefix {#sec-cmt-004}

**Mathlib** · Level **SHOULD**

The optional `<scope>` SHOULD name the affected module or directory with the leading `Mathlib` prefix omitted (e.g. `Data/Nat/Basic`).

**Acceptance criteria**

- Scopes are written without the `Mathlib` prefix.

**Rationale.** The prefix is redundant inside Mathlib and only lengthens the title.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html>

---

### CMT-005 — Moves, deletions, and dependencies in the message {#sec-cmt-005}

**Mathlib** · Level **SHOULD**

A PR that moves or deletes declarations SHOULD list them in `Moves:` / `Deletions:` sections in the commit message before the `---` separator; PRs that depend on others SHOULD list them in checkbox form, e.g. `- [ ] depends on: #1234`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- Moves and deletions are listed before `---`.
- Dependencies are listed as `- [ ] depends on: #XXXX`.

**Rationale.** Structured move/deletion/dependency metadata lets automation track API changes and merge order.

**Source.** <https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/how-to-contribute.html>
